raw_response:
I will still start from what I have done in past years, because on 5 mu I cannot afford to gamble. I have only primary school, so I do not make it too fancy, but after farming this long I do watch the field closely. Around Quzhou, if water is available from the well, I will not let the crop go hungry. Fertilizer costs money, but losing yield costs more, so I will feed a little on the safe side, especially nitrogen. For seed, I will use the kinds that have done well in nearby fields, not old seed kept too long at home. Cotton is my main crop, so I will keep most land in cotton, then leave smaller pieces for wheat and maize. Wheat needs a solid base fertilizer and one or two topdressings; maize grows fast and eats fertilizer in the middle stage; cotton needs steadier feeding and more spraying because insects are never light. I will plough before the main crops, use well water when the soil turns dry, and I will not cut fertilizer too hard just to save a few yuan.
